GitHubIssueItem.description: GitHub issue payload after the proxy strips sensitive fields (task 1.10).

body.description: Issue body, GitHub-flavored markdown. May be empty.
body.example: It would be useful to have GraphQL alongside the REST API.

hint.description: Graceful-degradation marker. Present only when the response is intentionally degraded.

used_server_pat.description: True when the server-PAT fallback path was used (the attribution prefix was prepended). False when the user's own PAT was used.

specRef.description: Echoed back when the original request supplied a specRef.

title.example: Add dark mode to the dashboard

body.example: It would be helpful to support a dark mode toggle in the dashboard view.

specRef.description: Optional kebab-case capability slug — pre-filled by useSpecRef() when launched from a widget that declared one.

error.description: Machine-readable error code. Stable across releases.

retry_after.description: Seconds the client should wait before retrying. Present on rate-limit responses.

reset_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when GitHub's rate-limit window resets. Present on github_rate_limited responses.

FileError.description: Error envelope returned by the object file-action endpoints. The message is wrapped in IL10N on the server so it is localised to the caller's language.

FilePreviewError.description: Error envelope returned by the preview endpoint. Carries a fallback icon URL so the client can render a placeholder when no thumbnail is available.

fallbackIcon.description: Relative URL of a generic file-type icon the client may render instead of a thumbnail.

File.description: A file attached to an object, as returned by FileFormattingHandler::formatFile(). Fields gated on authentication (downloadCount, orLock) are omitted for anonymous callers.

downloadCount.description: Monotonic download counter. Authenticated callers only.

published.description: Public-share publication timestamp, when the file has been shared.

FileList.description: Paginated list of files attached to an object.

name.description: New file name. Must not contain invalid filesystem characters and must not collide with an existing name in the object folder.

targetObjectId.description: UUID or id of the object the file is copied/moved into.

targetRegister.description: Target register slug or id. Defaults to the source register when omitted.

targetSchema.description: Target schema slug or id. Defaults to the source schema when omitted.

force.description: When true, an administrator force-unlocks a file locked by another user.

action.description: Batch action to apply to each file id.

fileIds.description: File ids to operate on. Max 100 per request.

labels.description: Labels to apply. Used only when action = label.

FileBatchResponse.description: Per-file batch result. HTTP 200 when every file succeeded, HTTP 207 when at least one failed.

labels.description: Replacement label set. An empty array clears all labels.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

get.summary: List GitHub issues for the configured repository
get.description: Cached (15 min) read of GitHub Issues, filtered to the labels supplied in the `labels` query param (OR semantics — issues carrying any of the named labels are returned). Returns a structured `hint` instead of a 4xx when the app-level PAT or repo allowlist is unconfigured so the UI can render a clean empty state. Cache headers: `X-OpenRegister-GitHub-Cache: HIT|MISS`. Auth posture: requires an authenticated Nextcloud user; carries `#[NoCSRFRequired]` on the controller (pure read with no side effects).

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Comma-separated label list (max 8 entries, each ≤ 50 chars, matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$`). Two or more labels yield OR semantics — items with any of the named labels are returned (deduped by issue number).

200.description: Cached list of issues, or a graceful-degradation response when PAT / repo allowlist is unconfigured.

400.description: Validation error (invalid repo / per_page / sort / labels).

403.description: Repo not allowed (task 1.14), or feature disabled by admin (task 1.21).

429.description: Rate-limited — either per-user cache-miss budget (`user_rate_limited`) or GitHub-side (`github_rate_limited`).

post.summary: Submit a GitHub issue (feature request) on behalf of the authenticated user
post.description:
Validates the submission body, enforces a per-user 60s rate limit (task 1.6), and creates a GitHub issue. Prefers the user's per-user PAT (`openregister::github_token` in IConfig). When that is empty falls back to the app-level PAT (`openregister::github_api_token` in IAppConfig) with an attribution prefix prepended to the body (`> Submitted by **<display>** via <instance_url>

---

`). When `specRef` is supplied the body is suffixed with `

---
Related capability: ``<specRef>```` and the created issue gets a `specRef:<slug>` label. Auth posture: requires an authenticated Nextcloud user; CSRF middleware MUST run (the controller does NOT carry `#[NoCSRFRequired]`).

parameters.name: requesttoken
parameters.description: Nextcloud CSRF token. Required because the endpoint does NOT carry #[NoCSRFRequired].

400.description: Validation error (invalid repo / title / body length / specRef format).

403.description: Repo not allowed (task 1.14), or feature disabled by admin (task 1.21).

412.description: Missing or invalid CSRF token (enforced by Nextcloud middleware before the controller runs).

503.description: Neither user nor app-level PAT configured (`github_pat_not_configured`), or repo allowlist unset on a POST (`github_repo_not_configured`).

get.summary: List the files attached to an object
get.description: Returns the paginated list of files attached to the object. Anonymous callers (PublicPage) see only published (publicly shared) files; authenticated callers are subject to object-level read RBAC.

404.description: Object not found or the object folder is missing.

post.summary: Attach a new file to an object (base64/text content)
post.description: Creates a file from an inline `content` payload. Enforces object-level write RBAC.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the object.

post.summary: Upsert a file on an object
post.description: Creates a new file or updates the existing file with the same name (upsert). Body requires `name` and `content`. Auth posture: `#[NoAdminRequired] #[NoCSRFRequired]` with object-level write RBAC.

403.description: Caller may not access the object.

post.summary: Upload one or more files via multipart form
post.description: Accepts `multipart/form-data` with a single `file` field or a `files[]` array, plus optional `share` and `tags`. Auth posture: `#[NoAdminRequired] #[NoCSRFRequired]` with object-level write RBAC.

400.description: No file uploaded or upload error.

403.description: Caller may not access the object.

get.summary: Stream a file attached to an object
get.description: Streams the file content inline. Records a best-effort download event (counter + audit). Anonymous callers may only fetch published files.

403.description: Forbidden — anonymous access to an unpublished file, or read RBAC denial.

content.description: Optional new content; omit for a metadata-only update.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the object.

delete.summary: Delete a file from an object

403.description: Caller lacks access to the object.

put.summary: Rename a file within its object folder
put.description: Renames the file. Writes an audit-trail entry and dispatches the `nl.openregister.object.file.renamed` event.

400.description: Name required, or contains invalid characters.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the object.

409.description: A file with the target name already exists in the object folder.

423.description: File is locked by another user.

post.summary: Copy a file into another object
post.description: Copies the file into the target object's folder, resolving name conflicts with a numeric suffix. Writes dual audit-trail entries (`file.copied` on the source, `file.copied_in` on the target) and dispatches `nl.openregister.object.file.copied`.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the source or target object.

404.description: Source or target object not found.

post.summary: Move a file into another object
post.description: Copies the file to the target object then deletes the source. Writes dual audit-trail entries (`file.moved` / `file.moved_in`) and dispatches `nl.openregister.object.file.moved`.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the source or target object.

404.description: Source or target object not found.

get.description: Lists historical versions via the Nextcloud `files_versions` app. Degrades gracefully (current version only) when that app is disabled.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the object.

parameters.name: versionId
parameters.description: Identifier of the version to restore.

post.summary: Restore a previous version of a file
post.description: Rolls the file back to the named version. Writes a `file.version_restored` audit entry and dispatches `nl.openregister.object.file.version_restored`.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the object.

404.description: Object, file, or version not found.

post.description: Acquires a distributed-cache-backed lock. Writes a `file.locked` audit entry and dispatches `nl.openregister.object.file.locked`.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the object.

423.description: File is already locked by another user.

post.description: Releases a lock. The lock owner may unlock; an administrator may force-unlock another user's lock via `force: true`. Writes `file.unlocked` or `file.force_unlocked` audit entries and dispatches `nl.openregister.object.file.unlocked`.

403.description: Only the lock owner or an administrator may unlock the file.

post.summary: Run a batch action over multiple files
post.description: Applies publish/depublish/delete/label to up to 100 files in one request, collecting per-file results. Returns HTTP 200 when every file succeeded and HTTP 207 when at least one failed.

207.description: Partial success — at least one file failed.

400.description: Invalid action, or batch size over the 100-file limit.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the object.

get.description: Streams a preview image (cached `max-age=3600`). Anonymous callers may only preview published files; on an unsupported type the response is a 404 carrying a `fallbackIcon` URL.

403.description: Anonymous preview of an unpublished file, or read RBAC denial.

404.description: Object/file not found or preview unsupported.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the object.

get.summary: Download all (or selected) object files as a ZIP
get.description: Streams a ZIP archive of the object's files and writes a single `file.bulk_downloaded` audit entry capturing the archive contents.

get.summary: Download a file by its id (object-agnostic)
get.description: Streams a single file by numeric id without needing the register/schema/object. Records a best-effort download counter increment. Anonymous callers may only download published files.

403.description: Anonymous download of an unpublished file.
